title: pasta's create modpack
body:
🔥 Pasta's modpack is back! A Create-focused, highly optimized modpack built for smooth automation and factory building.

## 📌 Description

🔥 Pasta's modpack is back!

⚡ Build it. Automate it. Perfect it.
🏭 Create. Automate. Dominate.
🚀 From simple gears to massive factories.

Welcome to pasta's create modpack, a carefully crafted modpack designed for players who love automation, engineering, and creativity.

At its core, this modpack is built around the Create mod, allowing you to design intricate machines, efficient production lines, and fully functional factories using mechanical systems instead of magic. ⚙️

Unlike heavy and unoptimized modpacks, this pack focuses on performance and stability. Every included mod has been selected with care to ensure smooth gameplay, reduced lag, and a clean experience even during large-scale automation. 🚀

Whether you're a beginner learning how gears and rotational power work, or an advanced player building massive automated systems, this modpack provides a balanced and enjoyable progression without unnecessary complexity.

Expand your creativity, push your engineering skills, and turn simple ideas into powerful machines.

### 💡 Perfect for players who:

Love automation and factory building
Enjoy Create-style mechanical systems
Want a smooth and optimized gameplay experience
Prefer a clean, focused modpack without clutter

Start small… and build something incredible.

### 📌 Features


**⚙️ Fully Create-centered gameplay experience**

**🚀 Optimized for performance and stability**

**🏭 Advanced automation & factory systems**

**🔧 Mechanical engineering-based progression**

**🧩 Carefully selected, lightweight, and compatible mods**

**💡 Beginner-friendly but scalable for advanced builds**




_📌 Notes_


**💻 Allocate at least 4–6GB RAM for best performance**

**⚠️ Performance may vary depending on system specs**

**👍 Recommended for modern systems and SSD users**
